recommendations.title: Epidemiology of Anterior Cruciate Ligament Injuries in the Top 5 European Football (Soccer) Leagues
recommendations.exclusionReason: Ineligible register, hospital, database, or public source
recommendations.reason: ACL cases, player characteristics, exposure, and mechanisms were reconstructed from Transfermarkt, public statements, websites, and video platforms rather than prospectively reported current-player outcomes from club or competition medical personnel.
recommendations.studyDesign: Retrospective descriptive epidemiology study using public online data
recommendations.populationEligibility: Male players in the top five European professional leagues
recommendations.competitionContext: Top divisions in England, Spain, Italy, Germany, and France
recommendations.dataSource: Transfermarkt, official public statements, public team/league websites, Wyscout, and online videos
recommendations.outcomeEligibility: ACL rupture counts, match incidence, and injury mechanisms
recommendations.injuryIllnessDefinition: ACL rupture identified in Transfermarkt and confirmed through public official statements
recommendations.denominatorEvidenceQuote: The total time of exposure in matches was 430,090.8 hours
evidenceQuotes: Data were retrieved from an online soccer database, Transfermarkt
data were not received directly from the medical personnel of each team
